label: Boiler or CHP with post-combustion capture
carriers: biomass; natural-gas; coal; nuclear; by-product-gas; oil; biogas
description: A boiler or CHP unit whose flue gas or exhaust is sent to capture. Regeneration steam is drawn from the unit itself, a host-side penalty that belongs here. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: [heat-low-temp] Flue gas is dilute, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse and its cost and energy are not repeated here. The steam taken for regeneration is the host-side penalty and belongs on this row. Biomass firing makes it a removal. [heat-medium-temp] Flue gas is dilute, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse and its cost and energy are not repeated here. Regeneration steam at 120-150 degC competes with the medium-temperature duties this band serves. Merged combined-cycle_ccs-diffuse (CHP with post-combustion capture) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 8. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Solid-fuel dryer
description: A direct-fired dryer burning coal, coke, biomass or coal tars.
note: Split from the gas- and liquid-fired dryer: UK TIMES costs solid-fuel units at 5-10 times the gas-fired unit. Coal tars are grouped here because UK TIMES costs them as coal.

label: Direct-fired dryer efficiency measures, strong
carriers: natural-gas; biogas; electricity; hydrogen; liquid-biomass; lpg; oil
description: The direct-fired dryer or curing oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for the UK TIMES advanced drying option.

label: Solid-fuel dryer efficiency measures, strong
description: The solid-fuel dryer with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23, split from dryer_direct-fired_efficiency-strong by fuel handling.

label: Direct-fired dryer efficiency measures, moderate
description: The direct-fired dryer or curing oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_direct-fired.

label: Direct-fired veneer and strand dryer
description: Hot gas from a burner or boiler drying veneer, strands and particles.

label: Fuel-fired heat-treatment furnace
description: Batch and continuous furnaces for annealing, normalizing and forging heat.

label: Electric or induction heat treatment
description: Resistance or induction heating for hardening, forging and annealing.

label: Continuous kiln with heat recovery
description: Continuous drying with zone heat recovery, at lower energy per cubic metre.

label: Dehumidification or heat-pump kiln
description: Heat-pump kiln recovering latent heat from the drying air.

label: Steam or thermal-oil lumber kiln
description: Batch kilns heated by hog-fuel boilers through steam or thermal oil.

label: Cupola or gas-fired melting furnace
description: Coke cupola or gas-fired furnace melting iron and non-ferrous metal in foundries.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t product). product-unit t, not GJ: every example is per tonne of metal melted (corrected 2026-10-02)

label: Electric arc melting furnace
description: Arc melting for steel and iron castings.

label: Induction melting and holding furnace
description: Coreless or channel induction melting, common in modern foundries.
note: Merged induction-heater_melting-holding (Induction melting and holding) 2026-09-23; it had family non-ferrous-metals.

label: All-electric injection moulding and extrusion
description: Servo-electric machines replacing hydraulic drives, with electric barrel heating.

label: Hot press with thermal-oil heater
description: Heated platens curing resin in plywood, OSB and MDF panels.

label: Infrared or ultraviolet curing
description: Radiant or photochemical curing in place of hot-air ovens.

label: Wood pellet mill
description: Dries, grinds and presses sawdust, shavings or chips into fuel pellets.
note: Not the iron-ore pellet-plant archetypes. Drying heat is usually from burning part of the residue. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Biomass torrefaction and pelletising
trl-basis: etsap_2013_010 (pilot and first commercial plants in 2013)
description: Roasts biomass at 250-300 degC without oxygen before pelletising, giving a denser, water-resistant fuel.

label: Steam-heated thermal processing efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice steam-heated kettles, retorts, blanchers and vats: heat recovery, insulation, controls and process redesign saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket (design doc s2): DOE state-of-the-art tiers 20-76% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Polymerization and extrusion efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice polymerization trains and extruders saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state-of-the-art tiers 21-83% below current typical (HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC, PET, PC, PS). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Washing and clean-in-place system
description: Product and container washing and clean-in-place systems on site hot water and steam.
note: Conventional host for cleaning-system_efficiency-moderate. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Ethylene oxide and glycol plant
description: Silver-catalysed oxidation of ethylene to ethylene oxide, with hydration to ethylene glycol; separates a nearly pure CO2 stream.
note: The by-product CO2 is concentrated (capture needs only drying and compression). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Anthraquinone hydrogen peroxide plant
description: Hydrogenation and air oxidation of an anthraquinone working solution, with extraction and distillation of hydrogen peroxide.

label: Urea synthesis and finishing
description: Reacts ammonia with CO2 from the ammonia plant to urea, with prilling or granulation.
note: Consumes ammonia-plant process CO2 (about 0.73 t CO2/t urea), which matters to ammonia capture accounting. Serves chemicals.product.urea, added to the snapshot 2026-09-30. Added 2026-09-25. Merged reactor_urea-total-recycle (Total-recycle (non-stripping) urea plant) 2026-10-02 [C27, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Biomass gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies biomass to syngas, shifts and cleans it to hydrogen and synthesises ammonia.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Coal gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies coal with oxygen, shifts and cleans the syngas and synthesises ammonia.
note: About 36 GJ/t and 3.2 t CO2/t against 28 GJ/t and 1.8 t for steam reforming (IEA 2021). No Canadian stock. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Haber-Bosch synthesis loop with air separation (component)
description: The ammonia synthesis loop and nitrogen supply, priced without the hydrogen plant.
note: A component: combined with the same source's electrolyser into reactor_haber-bosch-electrolytic. Serves no hierarchy node. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Electrolytic-hydrogen direct reduction with EAF (whole plant)
description: Electrolysers, a hydrogen shaft furnace and an electric arc furnace together, per tonne of steel.
note: Whole-route alternative to shaft-furnace_direct-reduction plus electric-arc-furnace; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Calcium sulphoaluminate clinker
description: Clinker based on ye'elimite, fired at about 1250 degC with less limestone.
note: Process CO2 20-50% below Portland clinker. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Hydrothermal calcium hydrosilicate binder
description: Binder made in an autoclave and ground, with no rotary kiln (e.g. Celitement).
note: Rests on one source value. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Oxy-fuel supercritical-CO2 power cycle
description: A natural-gas cycle burning in oxygen with supercritical CO2 as working fluid, delivering CO2 ready for storage (Allam cycle).

label: Ammonia plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice reforming, synthesis and heat integration in an ammonia plant, saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state of the art 46% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Conventional ECF bleach plant
description: Elemental-chlorine-free bleaching sequence with chlorine dioxide stages, without oxygen delignification.
note: Conventional host for reactor_oxygen-delignification. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Integrated bitumen upgrader with capture
description: An integrated bitumen upgrader whose concentrated hydrogen-plant or gasifier CO2 stream is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
examples-named: North West Redwater (Sturgeon); Quest at Scotford
note: Holds host-side facts; the capture plant is capture-unit_* on the ccs.concentrated node. Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: CO2 pipeline transport
description: Compression and pipeline transport of captured CO2 to a storage or EOR site.
note: Complement to well_co2-storage at the transmission nodes: each tonne needs both; they are not alternatives. Sources price it per tonne (cost-levelized) or per km of pipe. Added 2026-09-25.

label: CO2 injection and geological storage
description: Injection of CO2 into deep saline formations, depleted fields or oil fields (EOR), with monitoring.
note: Complement to pipeline_co2 at the transmission nodes; not an alternative to it. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Geothermal heat
description: Heat drawn from geothermal wells: hot water from a natural aquifer (direct use) or fluid circulated through stimulated hot rock (enhanced systems).
note: No source costs yet. Added 2026-09-25. Merged geothermal-well_direct-use (Geothermal direct use) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 8.

label: Steel off-gases to chemicals and fuels
description: Converts blast-furnace and coke-oven gases to methanol, ammonia or other chemicals (e.g. Carbon2Chem), using the carbon instead of emitting it.
examples-named: Gas fermentation of steel off-gases to ethanol
note: A utilisation alternative to capture on the steel mill's concentrated off-gas. Added 2026-09-26. Merged fermenter_steel-offgas (Gas fermentation of steel off-gases to ethanol) 2026-10-02 [C31, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type alternative, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Bayer alumina refining with CO2 capture
description: An alumina refinery whose calciner or boiler flue gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Holds host-side facts on the alumina node; the capture plant is a capture-unit_* archetype on metal-smelting.service.ccs.diffuse (node added 2026-09-26). Added 2026-09-26. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Ethylene from lignocellulosic gasification
description: Gasifies lignocellulosic biomass to syngas and converts it to ethylene (via methanol-to-olefins or Fischer-Tropsch).

label: Paper making without water
description: Forms paper by dry or foam forming, removing most of the water that the dryer section must evaporate.

label: Deep eutectic solvent pulping
description: Separates lignin from cellulose with deep eutectic solvents at low temperature and pressure instead of kraft cooking.

label: Ring rolling with variable wall thickness
description: Rolls rings with varying wall thickness close to final shape, cutting material and machining.
note: The hierarchy has no non-ferrous rolling node; linked to melting, casting and fabrication. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Prebaked anode cell with CO2 capture
description: An aluminium smelter whose dilute potline off-gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Holds host-side facts on the electrolysis node; the capture plant is a capture-unit_* archetype on metal-smelting.service.ccs.diffuse (node added 2026-09-26). Added 2026-09-26. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Hydro- or electrolytic non-ferrous smelting
description: Leaching and electrowinning, or direct electrolysis, in place of fuel-fired pyrometallurgical smelting of non-ferrous ores.
note: IPCC gives up to 99% reduction and an ore-specific cost. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Waste-heat recovery and heat-charged storage
description: Economizers and heat exchangers recovering heat from flue gas or process streams, and sensible or latent stores charged with that heat and discharged to a heat demand.
note: Storage costs are add-on (incremental) costs, pooled only with a base system cost from the same source. Added 2026-09-26. Merged heat-recovery-unit (Waste-heat recovery unit) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9.

label: Food and beverage evaporators
description: Multiple-effect or mechanical-vapour-recompression evaporators concentrating milk, juice or corn steepwater.
note: Type reference: kept for the numbers, not linked to the CIMS hierarchy, which does not resolve food preparation steps (modeller). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Low-shaft smelting reduction (Tecnored)
description: A single low-shaft furnace smelting cold-bonded self-reducing pellets or briquettes with fine coal or biomass and a hot air blast, without coke ovens or sinter.
note: Not two-stage smelting reduction (Corex/Finex has a separate pre-reduction shaft and oxygen-blown melter-gasifier). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Electrochemical cement from calcium silicates (Sublime)
description: Electrolysis at ambient temperature extracts calcium from non-carbonate calcium silicates and makes a cementitious binder without a kiln, so there is no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Sublime Systems route (MIT spin-out of Ellis et al. 2019); the IEA guide row on electrolytic limestone decarbonation ahead of a kiln is a different route and is not mapped here. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Portland clinker from calcium-silicate rock (Brimstone)
description: Dissolves calcium-silicate rock instead of limestone and fires the recovered calcium to ordinary Portland clinker, co-producing a supplementary cementitious material and magnesium; no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Combined-cycle gas turbine, power only
description: Gas turbine exhausting to a heat-recovery steam generator and condensing steam turbine; power only (combined-cycle CHP is merged into combustion-turbine_heat-recovery-steam-generator).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Sulphite chemical pulping
description: Acid or neutral sulphite cooking with its own liquor recovery chemistry; legacy Canadian sulphite and dissolving-pulp mills.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Beverage spirits distillery, whole plant
description: Whole beverage distillery (mashing, fermentation, pot or column stills, by-product handling), per volume of pure alcohol.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Ceramic ware dryer (chamber or tunnel)
description: Chamber or tunnel dryer removing forming water from green ceramic ware with hot air, often kiln exhaust.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Market pulp dryer
description: Airborne or cylinder dryer for market pulp sheets; about a quarter of a kraft mill's heat.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Through-air (TAD) tissue dryer
description: Through-air drying of premium tissue, roughly two to three times the energy of Yankee drying.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Diaphragm chlor-alkali cell
description: Diaphragm cell producing weak caustic that needs steam evaporation; legacy North American stock.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Copper electrorefining tankhouse
description: Electrolytic refining of fire-refined anodes to cathode copper.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Zinc electrowinning (roast-leach-electrowin)
description: Electrowinning of zinc from purified sulphate solution, the last step of the roast-leach-electrowin route.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Regenerative glass furnace with post-combustion capture
description: A regenerative glass melting furnace whose flue gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Rotary hearth furnace direct reduction
description: Coal-based reduction of composite pellets on a rotating hearth (Fastmet, Inmetco, ITmk3); about 20% above a gas-based shaft.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Thermal or catalytic oxidiser
description: Oxidises VOC-laden vent gas with support fuel; straight, recuperative, regenerative (90-97% heat recovery) or catalytic (300-500 degC).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Merged gas-treatment-unit_regenerative-oxidiser (Regenerative thermal oxidiser) 2026-10-02 [C37, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type reference, trl 9, product-unit m3. Merged gas-treatment-unit_catalytic-oxidiser (Catalytic oxidiser) 2026-10-02 [C37, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type reference, trl 9, product-unit m3.

label: Coal gasification to methanol
description: Coal or lignite gasification and synthesis to methanol: 58-72 GJ/t against 33-37 for gas reforming, about 5 t CO2/t.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Waste-to-energy incineration plant
description: Whole plant: waste reception, grate furnace-boiler, flue-gas cleaning and turbine, per t of waste; fossil and biogenic CO2.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Cement kiln with integrated calcium looping
description: Calciner and preheater rebuilt so the kiln concentrates its own CO2 with a CaO sorbent loop; more fuel, power export.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Intermittent ceramic kiln (shuttle or hood)
description: Batch-fired shuttle or hood kiln; roughly twice the energy per t of a tunnel or roller kiln.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Long rotary lime kiln
description: Long rotary kiln burning limestone without a preheater: 6.0-9.2 GJ/t, about 18% above the preheater rotary kiln; legacy stock.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Rotary kiln for expanded clay aggregate
description: Rotary kiln expanding clay pellets into lightweight aggregate at about 1100-1200 degC.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Ceramic tunnel or roller kiln, strong efficiency measures
description: Low-mass kiln cars and fibre insulation, heat recycling between cooling and firing zones; more than 15% saving.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Gas-fired crucible melting furnace
description: Fuel-fired crucible furnace for non-ferrous foundry metal: 2,500-4,000 Btu/lb, about double a reverberatory.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Electric resistance melting furnace
description: Resistance-heated crucible or radiant-roof reverberatory for aluminium and other non-ferrous foundry metal.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Hot-blast cupola for stone wool
description: Coke-fired shaft melting rock for stone wool, with afterburner; different fuel and emissions from glass furnaces.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Isothermal (immersion) melting furnace
description: Immersed electric heaters with metal circulation; about 26% below electric resistance melting; single installation.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Reverberatory or rotary melting furnace, strong efficiency measures
description: Improved lining, preheat hearth and metal circulation: about 18% saving.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Oxy-fuel rotary iron melting furnace
description: Oxy-gas rotary furnace melting cast iron: 600-800 kWh/t against 950-1,200 for the cupola, with gas rather than coke emissions.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Shaft or stack melter with charge preheating
description: Gas-fired tower melter preheating the charge in its stack (aluminium and non-ferrous foundry metal).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Merged melting-furnace_stack (Stack melter) 2026-10-02 [C01, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Hydrogen combustion-engine mobile equipment
description: Spark-ignited hydrogen engine: 30-40% efficient against 40-50% for diesel and 40-60% for a fuel cell; no CO2.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Fibreboard (MDF) refiner
description: Pressurised refiner defibrating chips for MDF and fibreboard: 0.13-0.4 MWh/t dry fibre.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Stone or pressure groundwood
description: Grinding logs against a stone (GW, PGW); legacy mechanical pulp with little steam recovery.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Ammonium nitrate and CAN plant
description: Neutralisation of nitric acid with ammonia, evaporation and prilling or granulation (AN, CAN, ANS); can export steam.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Ethylene oxide reactor with capture of the process CO2
description: An ethylene oxide plant whose concentrated by-product CO2 from the scrubber is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Visbreaker
description: Mild thermal cracking of residue in a coil or soaker without coke make: 400-800 MJ/t fuel against 800-1200 for delayed coking.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Nickel matte refinery
description: Refining of nickel matte to metal (chlorine leach-electrowinning or carbonyl), 17-20 GJ/t Ni.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Beet sugar factory, whole plant
description: Whole beet sugar factory (diffusion, juice purification, evaporation, crystallisation, pulp drying), 0.15-0.40 MWh/t beets.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Membrane bioreactor effluent treatment
description: Activated sludge with submerged membranes replacing the clarifier; about twice the energy of conventional activated sludge.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Steam methane reformer with capture on the flue gas
trl-basis: assessed (post-combustion amine on reformer flue gas; ieaghg_2017_001, ieaghg_2017_002)
description: A steam methane reformer whose reformer-furnace flue gas (diluted CO2) is sent to post-combustion capture; holds the host plant only, the capture plant is capture-unit_amine.
examples-named: IEAGHG 2017-02 case 3; ReCAP SMR flue gas
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake (two sources)

label: Geothermal flash-steam power
description: A flash-steam cycle generating power from high-temperature geothermal brine.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Electric alumina calciner
description: Calcines alumina hydrate with electric heating; no combustion emissions.
note: added 2026-10-02: different emissions kind from calciner_gas-suspension

label: Hydrogen-fired alumina calciner
trl-basis: assessed (deloitte_2022_001, mpp_2023_001; Rio Tinto Yarwun demonstration)
description: Calcines alumina hydrate with hydrogen firing (air or oxy-fired).
note: added 2026-10-02: different emissions kind from calciner_gas-suspension

label: Tail-end calcium-looping capture
description: A carbonator captures CO2 from flue gas on lime; an oxy-fired calciner regenerates the sorbent and releases concentrated CO2. Burns its own fuel, unlike solvent units that draw steam.
note: added 2026-10-02; the integrated version stays on the host (kiln_calcium-looping)

label: Electrified clinker kiln (plasma)
description: A clinker line whose kiln and calciner are heated by plasma torches and electric flow heaters instead of fuel.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Oxy-fuel glass furnace with thermochemical heat recovery
trl-basis: assessed (zier_2021_001 gives 4-5; Optimelt demonstrated at plant scale)
description: Oxy-fuel furnace whose flue gas reforms the natural gas before firing, recovering waste heat as fuel; about 20% less fuel than oxy-fuel.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Heat transformer (heat-driven heat pump)
description: An absorption or chemical heat pump driven by waste heat that lifts part of it to a higher temperature (COP below 1, no compressor).
note: added 2026-10-02: different energy basis from the electric heat-pump_industrial

label: Microwave-assisted gas kiln
description: A gas-fired ceramic kiln with part of the heat (about 10%) from microwaves, cutting total heat per tonne by about 40%.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Superheated-steam dryer
description: A direct dryer using superheated steam instead of hot air as the drying medium; the evaporated water can be recovered by vapour recompression.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Acid-catalyzed transesterification
description: Homogeneous acid catalyst tolerates free fatty acids in waste oils but needs a large methanol excess and recovery duty.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Supercritical-methanol transesterification
description: Non-catalytic transesterification in supercritical methanol (about 350 degC).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: CO2-to-ethanol
description: Ethanol synthesised from hydrogen and captured CO2 (through methanol and DME).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: CO2-to-higher alcohols
description: Butanols and iso-octanol synthesised from hydrogen and captured CO2.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: CO2-to-dimethyl ether
description: Dimethyl ether from hydrogen and captured CO2 by methanol synthesis and dehydration.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: CO2-to-OME1 (methylal)
description: Oxymethylene dimethyl ether (methylal) from hydrogen and captured CO2 through methanol and formaldehyde.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: CO2-to-OME3-5
description: Oxymethylene dimethyl ethers OME3-5 (a diesel substitute) from hydrogen and captured CO2 through methanol, formaldehyde and trioxane or methylal.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake (two sources)

label: CO2-to-gasoline (methanol-to-gasoline)
description: Gasoline from e-methanol by the methanol-to-gasoline process.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: CO2-to-Fischer-Tropsch fuels
description: Reverse water-gas shift plus Fischer-Tropsch synthesis making jet fuel and diesel from hydrogen and captured CO2.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake

label: Mercury chlor-alkali cell
description: Mercury-cathode chlor-alkali cell; legacy stock using about 30% more electricity per t Cl2 than membrane cells.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave; legacy Canadian stock

label: Mixed-feed or annular shaft lime kiln
description: Vertical shaft kiln (mixed-feed, annular or single-shaft) burning lime with counter-current heat exchange.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Oil sands surface mine and extraction plant
description: Truck-and-shovel oil sands mine with hot-water extraction and froth treatment, producing diluted bitumen.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave; whole-plant archetype, like mine_open-pit-coal

label: Electromagnetic (radio-frequency) heating with solvent
description: In-situ bitumen recovery heating the reservoir with radio-frequency antennae and a solvent instead of steam.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: In-situ oxy-combustion steam generation
description: Steam generated downhole by oxy-fuel combustion, with the combustion CO2 left in the reservoir.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Wet-seal degassing gas recovery
description: Recovers the gas flashed from centrifugal-compressor wet-seal oil and routes it to fuel or suction instead of venting.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Low-bleed pneumatic controllers
description: Gas-driven pneumatic controllers with low continuous bleed (below about 6 scf/h).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Ventilation-air methane oxidiser
description: Regenerative thermal or catalytic oxidiser destroying the dilute methane in coal-mine ventilation air.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Anode-effect control for PFC reduction
description: Point feeders, computer control and work-practice changes cutting anode-effect frequency and PFC emissions.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Magnesium chloride electrolysis
description: Electrolysis of anhydrous MgCl2 to magnesium metal and chlorine (Norsk Hydro, Magnola).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Silicothermic (Pidgeon) magnesium reduction
description: Retort reduction of calcined dolomite with ferrosilicon (Pidgeon or Magnetherm process; Timminco).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Propane dehydrogenation
description: Catalytic dehydrogenation of propane to propylene (Oleflex, Catofin).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Mine ventilation fans
description: Main and auxiliary fans ventilating an underground mine.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Underground hydrogen storage (salt or lined rock cavern)
description: Compressed hydrogen stored in a solution-mined salt cavern or a lined rock cavern.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Gas fermentation of hydrogen and CO2

label: Electrolytic limestone decarbonation

label: Oxy-fuel boiler
description: Boiler fired on oxygen (from an air separation unit or an oxygen-conducting membrane) and recycled flue gas, so the flue gas is CO2-rich and needs only purification and compression.

label: Pipeline work without blowdown
description: Maintenance and connection practices that keep a pipeline or meter-run segment in service, or drive its gas into the line, instead of venting the isolated segment.
examples-named: hot taps; composite wrap repair; pig and inert-gas purges; longer turbine-meter module intervals; ultrasonic meters
note: Added 2026-10-03 for the Natural Gas STAR documents set aside on 2026-10-02 (Brad). The assets sit on natural-gas transmission and distribution lines; mapped to supply.venting.blowdowns, where CIMS prices blowdown methane in t CH4. Product is t CH4 avoided per year (abated), as the CIMS model prices natural-gas.product.supply.venting.* (except controls) and supply.fugitive in t CH4; per t CH4 of service handled = per t avoided x the reduction share (modeller 2026-10-02).
